tha-ap455:1.2: bodhirukkhamavandiyaṁ paggayha bījaniṁ → bodhirukkhamavandisaṁ paggayhaṁ vījaniṁ (bj) | bodhirukkhamavandiyaṁ → bodhirukkhaṁ avandihaṁ (sya-all, pts)
tha-ap455:1.4: sīhāsanamabījahaṁ → sīhāsanamavījayiṁ (bj); sīhāsanamavijjahaṁ (sya-all); sīhāsanam avīj ahaṁ (pts) | sīhāsanamabījahaṁ → mabījayiṁ (cck: sī.); mavijjahaṁ (cck: syā.)
